title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the multiple-choice BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) benchmark to calculate an Accuracy-Scaled Bias Score (AccSc) in ambiguous contexts, alongside open-ended generation evaluations scored by a GPT-4o judge to detect gender stereotypes (e.g., women-domestic, men-leadership).
